prompt: My son finally admitted (to drop) his phone in the bath.
explanation_ru: После глагола admit используется герундий (-ing) или форма having + V3 для прошедшего действия (также допустим вариант с предлогом to + -ing). Инфинитив с to здесь не подходит.

prompt: Why did Diego refuse (to change) roles before the school play?
explanation_ru: После глагола refuse всегда ставится инфинитив с частицей to (refuse to do something). Герундий или придаточное с that после refuse не употребляются.

prompt: At our goodbye dinner, Yumi promised ___ to me from Osaka.
explanation_ru: Глагол promise требует инфинитива с частицей to (promise to do something). Частая ошибка — ставить после promise герундий или конструкцию с предлогом for.

prompt: A cyclist rang his bell loudly in Amsterdam. The tourist quickly apologised (to walk) in the bike lane.
explanation_ru: Глагол apologise требует предлога for и герундия (apologise for doing something). Ставить инфинитив с to после apologise нельзя.

prompt: We arrived late at a small guesthouse in Lisbon. The owner's teenage son was at reception and promised (to serve) us breakfast at eleven. When we came downstairs, the kitchen was locked and he admitted (to forget) to tell the cook. To make up for it, he insisted (to pay) for our coffee at the corner café.
explanation_ru: После promise нужен инфинитив с to (promised to serve), после admit — герундий (admitted forgetting), а глагол insist требует предлога on и герундия (insisted on paying).

prompt: My tennis partner suggested to hit shorter shots during the match.
answer: My tennis partner suggested hitting shorter shots during the match.
accepted_answers: My tennis partner suggested hitting shorter shots during the match.
My tennis partner suggested that we hit shorter shots during the match.
My tennis partner suggested we hit shorter shots during the match.
My tennis partner suggested that we should hit shorter shots during the match.
My tennis partner suggested we should hit shorter shots during the match.
explanation_ru: После suggest нельзя использовать инфинитив с to — это типичная ошибка. Правильно употребить герундий (suggested hitting) или придаточное предложение с that.

prompt: Grace saw the tired man at the café and offered (to carry) his bag.
explanation_ru: После глагола offer используется инфинитив с частицей to (offer to do something). Лицо, которому предлагают помощь, перед этим инфинитивом не ставится.

prompt: Bianca looked down at the floor and did not deny (to copy) her roommate's answers.
explanation_ru: После глагола deny требуется герундий (-ing) или перфектный герундий (having copied), когда речь идёт о прошлом действии. Инфинитив с to после deny ошибочен.

prompt: At a Dutch farm, the farmer told the inspector, "I won't spray the fields before the rain." Which report is correct?
options: The farmer promised the inspector not spraying the fields before the rain.
The farmer promised not to spray the fields before the rain.
The farmer refused to not spray the fields before the rain.
The farmer threatened not to spray the fields before the rain.
explanation_ru: Обещание не делать чего-либо передаётся конструкцией promise not to + инфинитив. Вариант с герундием грамматически неверен, а refuse и threaten искажают смысл обещания.

prompt: In our gym class, Paulo agreed (to run) slowly but refused (to jump).
explanation_ru: Оба глагола — agree (соглашаться) и refuse (отказываться) — требуют после себя инфинитива с частицей to.

prompt: Our family group chat went completely silent after an old holiday photo appeared at midnight. At first, my sister accused Tariq (to post) it on purpose to tease her. He strongly denied (to want) everyone to see it and insisted (it / to be) an accident. Five minutes later, he apologised (to wake) our aunt up and deleted the picture.
explanation_ru: После accuse + дополнение ставится of + -ing, после deny — герундий, после insist с подлежащим — придаточное с that и сдвигом времени, а после apologise — предлог for + -ing.

prompt: The building's only lift broke down overnight. After the inspection, the manager admitted ___ closed until the new motor arrived.
explanation_ru: Когда у сообщаемого действия есть своё подлежащее (the lift), после admit используется придаточное с that и сдвигом времени (would stay). Ставить после admit прямое дополнение без to (admit us) или инфинитив с to нельзя.

prompt: A microphone went missing during the break at the concert in Ghana. The manager accused the sound engineer for losing it.
answer: A microphone went missing during the break at the concert in Ghana. The manager accused the sound engineer of losing it.
accepted_answers: A microphone went missing during the break at the concert in Ghana. The manager accused the sound engineer of losing it.
A microphone went missing during the break at the concert in Ghana. The manager accused the sound engineer of having lost it.
A microphone went missing during the break at the concert in Ghana. The manager blamed the sound engineer for losing it.
A microphone went missing during the break at the concert in Ghana. The manager blamed the sound engineer for having lost it.
explanation_ru: После глагола accuse нужен предлог of, а не for (accuse somebody of doing something). Предлог for используется с глаголом blame, поэтому их часто путают.

prompt: Uncle Samuel warned his niece (not / to climb) the wet mango tree.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном предупреждении после warn + дополнение частица not ставится перед инфинитивом с to (warn someone not to do something).

prompt: "I'm sorry I missed the appointment because of the late bus," Abena told the nurse. → Abena apologised to the nurse …
answer: Abena apologised to the nurse for missing the appointment because of the late bus.
accepted_answers: Abena apologised to the nurse for missing the appointment because of the late bus.
Abena apologised to the nurse for having missed the appointment because of the late bus.
explanation_ru: Извинение передаётся конструкцией apologise (to somebody) for + герундий (for missing или for having missed). Важно сохранить предлог for и не заменить герундий инфинитивом.

prompt: Although the security guard threatened (to send) him out of the concert in Argentina, the fan still denied (to stand) on the barrier.
explanation_ru: После threaten всегда употребляется инфинитив с частицей to (threatened to send), а после deny — герундий (denied standing / having stood).

prompt: I took a taxi across Istanbul and handed the driver a fifty-lira note. He looked embarrassed and admitted (not / to have) any small change in the car. I did not want to wait, so I suggested (to stop) at a bakery on the corner. The driver agreed (to wait) with my bags while I bought a bottle of water to break the note.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном герундии после admit частица not стоит перед -ing (admitted not having); после suggest также нужен герундий (suggested stopping), а после agree — инфинитив с to (agreed to wait).

prompt: The host warned his guest ___ over the low balcony wall.
explanation_ru: После warn + дополнение в отрицании используется форма not to + инфинитив (warned him not to lean). Частые ошибки — ставить to перед not или сохранять повелительное don't.

prompt: Our yoga teacher admitted falling asleep during her own evening class.
answer: Our yoga teacher admitted falling asleep during her own evening class.
accepted_answers: Our yoga teacher admitted falling asleep during her own evening class.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: глагол admit грамматически верно употреблён с герундием (admitted falling asleep).

prompt: Did the finalist really admit (to practise) only twice before the table tennis final in Shanghai?
explanation_ru: После глагола admit используется герундий (practising) или перфектный герундий (having practised) для более раннего действия. Вопросительная форма главного предложения не меняет эту модель.

prompt: Everyone in our Bangalore office went quiet when the screen suddenly turned blank. Ravi admitted (to close) the file without saving his morning's work. Nobody blamed him (to make) a mistake after such a tiring week. Instead, Priya offered (to check) the backup folder with him before lunch.
explanation_ru: После admit нужен герундий (closing / having closed), после blame + дополнение — предлог for и герундий (for making), а после offer — инфинитив с to (to check).

prompt: The chemist in Marrakesh advised me (to drink) more water.
explanation_ru: Когда после глагола advise указано дополнение (me), за ним всегда следует инфинитив с частицей to (advise somebody to do something).

prompt: The whole lab smelled strongly of vinegar. Tomasz apologised ___ the two white powders by mistake.
explanation_ru: Глагол apologise требует предлога for и герундия (apologised for mixing up). Типичная ошибка — ставить инфинитив с to, предлог of или придаточное с that.

prompt: An old farmer in Kenya advised the couple (to plant) the corn early and suggested (to use) the lower field.
explanation_ru: После advise с дополнением (the couple) ставится инфинитив с to (to plant), а после suggest без подлежащего используется только герундий (using).

prompt: Snow was melting high in the mountains of Nepal, and the narrow river looked rough. Dawa warned our group (the water / to rise) quickly after dark. When one hiker wanted to push on, our guide insisted (to stay) on the safe bank until morning. Everyone finally agreed (to put up) the tents early, and we stayed dry all night.
explanation_ru: После warn с отдельным подлежащим строится придаточное с that и сдвигом времени (that the water would rise); после insist нужен предлог on + герундий (on staying), а после agree — инфинитив с to (to put up).

prompt: Before the work began at the Roman villa in southern Italy, the team leader promised the landowner not digging near the ancient olive trees.
answer: Before the work began at the Roman villa in southern Italy, the team leader promised the landowner not to dig near the ancient olive trees.
accepted_answers: Before the work began at the Roman villa in southern Italy, the team leader promised the landowner not to dig near the ancient olive trees.
Before the work began at the Roman villa in southern Italy, the team leader promised the landowner that they would not dig near the ancient olive trees.
Before the work began at the Roman villa in southern Italy, the team leader promised the landowner that they wouldn't dig near the ancient olive trees.
Before the work began at the Roman villa in southern Italy, the team leader promised the landowner that she would not dig near the ancient olive trees.
Before the work began at the Roman villa in southern Italy, the team leader promised the landowner that she wouldn't dig near the ancient olive trees.
explanation_ru: Глагол promise не употребляется с герундием: вместо not digging требуется отрицательный инфинитив not to dig (или придаточное предложение с that + would not).

prompt: Nobody knew if the lake in Norway was safe. In the chat, Lars apologised (to forget) the morning ice check.
explanation_ru: После глагола apologise всегда ставится предлог for и герундий (for forgetting или for having forgotten для прошлого действия).

prompt: In a Helsinki lab, Dr Virtanen saw two bottles with faded labels and told her students, "Do not mix these two liquids under any circumstances." Which sentence reports her words accurately?
options: Dr Virtanen suggested her students not mixing the two liquids from the unmarked bottles.
Dr Virtanen refused her students to mix the two liquids from the unmarked bottles.
Dr Virtanen warned her students not to mix the two liquids from the unmarked bottles.
Dr Virtanen threatened her students not to mix the two liquids from the unmarked bottles.
explanation_ru: Для строгого предостережения подходит модель warn + дополнение + not to + инфинитив. Глаголы suggest, refuse и threaten не сочетаются так с дополнением и искажают смысл.

prompt: My suitcase felt twice as heavy when I saw the narrow wooden stairs at our Hanoi guesthouse. Mrs Linh noticed me struggling and offered (to keep) the big bag behind the front desk. When I tried to pick up my backpack too, she insisted (to carry) it upstairs herself. She also suggested (to take) a rest before dinner, which I gladly did.
explanation_ru: После offer ставится инфинитив с to (offered to keep), после insist — предлог on и герундий (insisted on carrying), а после suggest — герундий без предлога (suggested taking).

prompt: Because the desert wind was growing stronger before the outdoor film in Morocco, the organiser ___ near the tall screen poles.
options: suggested the family not to sit
explanation_ru: Конструкция advise somebody against + -ing означает «отсоветовать кому-либо делать что-то». После suggest и refuse нельзя ставить «дополнение + инфинитив», а после warn нужно not to sit или against sitting.

prompt: When the nurse in Auckland checked his chart, the nervous patient finally admitted (to skip) his daily vitamins for two weeks and promised (to start) again.
explanation_ru: После admit используется герундий (skipping / having skipped), а после promise — инфинитив с частицей to (to start).

prompt: Strong desert gusts shook the tall crane at the building site in Abu Dhabi. Karim warned the crew (the crane / to be) unsafe in such strong gusts. One young driver still wanted to move a lorry underneath, so Karim refused (to let) anyone near the gate. He then recommended (to move) the whole shift indoors until the storm passed.
explanation_ru: С отдельным подлежащим после warn строится придаточное с that и сдвигом времени (that the crane was); после refuse нужен инфинитив с to (to let), а после recommend без дополнения — герундий (moving).
